title: Floors
description: New floors from the tower, and a floor's repos: a floor for a folder that already holds a project, or a new project started from scratch, added to the config through config/add; a floor's repos changed through config/append and config/remove.

root.description: The absolute folder the New floor form starts in, and puts new projects under. The user's home folder when unset.

words.label: New floor
words.hint: a floor for a project folder or a new project

words.label: New floor
words.hint: a floor for a project folder or a new project

add.description: Add a floor whose hub is a folder that already exists, such as a project already on the machine, with the other folders its sessions also work in as its repos. Refused when a folder doesn't exist, a repo is the hub or is named twice, or the config already has a floor of that id.

id.description: The floor's id in the config: letters, digits, `_` and `-`.

name.description: The name the floor is shown by.

hub.description: The absolute folder its sessions start in by default; the new-worker form can start one elsewhere.

repos.description: Other absolute folders its sessions also work in, none when left out: each must exist and not be the hub.

words.label: Add a floor
words.hint: a floor for a folder already on the machine

start.description: Start a project from scratch: a new folder, a git repository in it with a first commit holding a README (so worktrees can be cut from it), then a floor whose hub is that folder. Refused when the folder exists and isn't empty.

into.description: The absolute folder to start the project in, made with its parents.

words.label: Start a project
words.hint: a new folder and git repository, and a floor for it

add-repo.description: Add a folder to a floor's repos, the folders its sessions also work in besides the hub, through config/append. A folder the floor's repos hold already answers `unchanged`. Refused when the folder doesn't exist or is the hub.

path.description: The repo, as the config holds it.

words.label: Add a repo
words.hint: another folder this floor's sessions work in

remove-repo.description: Remove a folder from a floor's repos, through config/remove with the repo as read: refused (`changed`) when the repos changed in between, so read them again. The folder itself is left as it is.

path.description: The repo to remove, as the config holds it.
The repo, as the config holds it.

words.label: Remove a repo
words.hint: the folder stays; the floor's sessions stop working in it

dirs.description: The folders in a folder, to pick a floor's from: each one's name and whether it is a git repository. Dot folders are left out.

path.description: The absolute folder to list; the settings' root when left out.

parent.description: The folder holding it; none at /.

root.description: Where the form starts, and puts new projects: the settings' root, or the home folder.

git.description: Whether the folder listed is a git repository's top.

guidance.brief: New floors and a floor's repos: `tower x floors add|start` adds a floor for a folder on the machine or a new project; `add-repo` and `remove-repo` change a floor's repos.
guidance.full: When the user asks for a new floor or to change a floor's repos, use this extension's verbs rather than editing config.json by hand: `add` for a folder already on the machine (`{"id", "name", "hub", "repos"?}`), `start` for a project from scratch (`{"id", "name", "into"}`, a git repository with a first commit), `add-repo` and `remove-repo` (`{"project", "path"}`) for the other folders a floor's sessions work in. The hub is where its sessions start by default; repos are other folders they also work in. `tower x floors dirs '{"path": "/abs"}'` lists a folder's folders.
